candidates.name: GroundWaterML 2 (GWML2)
verified_facts: GWML2 describes conceptual and logical models for exchange of groundwater data.
The standard includes a GML/XML encoding for groundwater information.
semantic_limits: Groundwater observations or hydrogeologic model data are not equivalent to bare-earth surface elevation and cannot replace parcel DTM evidence.

candidates.name: EO Dataset Metadata GeoJSON(-LD)
verified_facts: The standard defines GeoJSON and JSON-LD encodings for Earth Observation dataset metadata.
It can encode metadata based on OGC Earth Observation metadata profiles or UMM-G conceptual models.
semantic_limits: EO metadata describes datasets but is not the underlying raster/observation measurement and cannot establish pixel elevation accuracy by itself.
